text:
nina: heads-up vendor-skyport flagged H100 eu hold: customs flagged hscode mismatch -> estimated 10->18d. may block Dedicated pools for next sprint.

vendor-skyport: confirmed. root cause: broker used legacy hscode on 2 containers. options: (A) origin preflight inspection + correct hscode upload (adds 48h) and reduces customs redelivery hold risk; (B) air split 10 units (48-72h) surcharge $2.6k/unit; (C) full ocean and escalate broker (12-18d). we can include preprinted rma labels, crate photos, and serial manifest if amendment signed.

maya: need manifest csv + sample crate checklist + rma label format. also want origin preflight report schema so ops can ingest.

vendor-skyport: will upload manifest + preflight_template.csv in 90m. rma label: SKY_{depot}_{po}_{serial}. preflight report will include serial, tests_run, pass_flag, photo_md5.

sam: back-of-envelope: air 10*2600 = 26k. preflight for 40 units = 40*120 = 4.8k. If preflight avoids customs rework, big win.

```
air_cost = 10*2600 = 26000
preflight_cost = 40*120 = 4800
```

sam: lean toward preflight + spares vs air unless customs refuses.

ops-eu: if you do preflight, ops can relax 24h photo SLA to 48h for origin-tested crates, but require manifest.sha256 and photo_md5 match. Also need RMA pickup <=72h for failures.

jess: add clause: vendor must provide crate-level photo + manifest within 2h of pickup and include pickup_ticket id when RMA scheduled.

nina: procurement-bot open PO amendment: include origin preflight for all ocean lots, 2 spares per 100, preprinted rma labels, manifest.sha256, and pilot: first 2 crates photo <=8h. flag finance for one-off preflight spend.

procurement-bot: PO 88222_amendment created -> routing to @finance. includes preflight line items and rma/photo SLA.

finance: approved preflight spend under code 4444 up to $6k. if air chosen, open a separate expedite approval.

vendor-skyport: uploaded manifest_1824681357.csv and preflight_template.csv. starting preflight run now; will attach test_report and crate photos when done. thanks.

maya: noted. ops please validate sha256 on ingest and confirm whether depot will accept relaxed SLA once validated.

ops-eu: will validate manifest.sha256 and photo_md5. prepping depot for RMA pickup routing. will report back within 48h.
